name: screencomp-workspace
description: The Nx project graph's toolchain for the screencomp repository (Nx; the YAML parser the workflow-contract tests read workflows with; and the PR-title action itself, from the tag its workflow uses, whose built entry point those tests run over sample titles), plus the Playwright suite's dependencies. Never published: bun installs it from the one root bun.lock (`just bootstrap`, or healed by tools/workspace/node-modules.sh). The shipped CLI's version comes from Cargo.toml.
